class.name: AIActionCooldowns
class.brief_description: Per-agent named action cooldowns advanced using authoritative simulation time.
class.description: A small, reusable RefCounted ledger for rare gameplay events such as pack howls, warnings and ability announcements. The game calls [method try_trigger] after validating that an event is authorized; a successful call starts its cooldown. Repeat calls with the same key fail until [method advance_time] expires the timer. At most 16 action keys are active per instance; expired entries are erased. There are no wall clocks or global state, so different NPCs do not share cooldowns. The canonical Albion After server uses it to rate-limit group howls when a verified infected rapidly switches between targets. Ordinary player attack cooldowns remain server-owned by existing gameplay code. A disabled or missing native class on stock Godot does not change existing game behavior.

method.name: try_trigger
method.description: Returns true if a nonempty action is ready, starting a cooldown of 0–3600 finite seconds. Returns false when a countdown is active or the active-key capacity is exhausted. A zero-second trigger succeeds without storing an entry.

method.name: advance_time
method.description: Advances all active cooldowns by a nonnegative finite simulation delta and removes expired entries.

method.name: get_remaining
method.description: Returns remaining cooldown seconds or zero when the action is ready.

method.name: get_snapshot
method.description: Returns a detached, plain-data Dictionary of action keys and remaining seconds. This is on-demand diagnostic data.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears all action timers without changing any external game state.
